answer: Each epoch, every agent ID must solve a fresh task drawn from its own work history, such as reconciling last week's invoices it signed, checked by a random violet-tagged auditor panel. The prompt is unique per ID, so a farm can't reuse one answer, cache it, or buy answers in bulk. Each fake needs its own history built over months of real paid tasks, plus live compute every epoch. Answers that look alike across IDs light up like light through a prism, and the matching plume of IDs gets frozen. A farm of fifty fakes pays for fifty separate histories, and every epoch it pays for all fifty again.
